# @rockcoredev/http - LLM Integration Notes

Purpose
- Isomorphic TypeScript HTTP client built on top of global fetch.
- Works in Node.js 18+, browsers, and edge runtimes.
- Package name: @rockcoredev/http

Install
- yarn add @rockcoredev/http

Primary API
- createHttpClient(config?)
- client methods:
  - request<T>(path, options?)
  - get<T>(path, options?)
  - post<T>(path, options?)
  - put<T>(path, options?)
  - patch<T>(path, options?)
  - delete<T>(path, options?)

Basic Example
```ts
import { createHttpClient } from '@rockcoredev/http';

type User = { id: string; name: string };

const http = createHttpClient({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
  timeoutMs: 5000,
  headers: { authorization: 'Bearer <token>' }
});

const user = await http.get<User>('/users/1');
await http.post('/users', { json: { name: 'Alice' } });
```

Config: createHttpClient
- baseUrl?: string
- headers?: HeadersInit
- timeoutMs?: number
- fetchFn?: typeof fetch
- requestsPerSecond?: number
- retry?: RetryConfig
- proxy?: ProxyConfig

Request Options (extends RequestInit)
- query?: Record<string, QueryValue>
- json?: unknown
- body?: BodyInit | null
- timeoutMs?: number
- retry?: RetryConfig | false
- proxy?: ProxyConfig | false
- plus standard RequestInit fields (method, signal, credentials, etc.)

Retry Behavior
- Default retry methods: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT, DELETE
- Default retry statuses: 408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504
- Exponential backoff fields:
  - attempts?: number
  - delayMs?: number
  - maxDelayMs?: number
  - backoffFactor?: number
  - retryOnStatuses?: number[]
  - retryOnMethods?: string[]
- AbortError is not retried.
- HttpError is not retried.

Rate Limiting
- requestsPerSecond limits total throughput per client instance.
- Applies across concurrent calls made through the same client.

Proxy Support
- proxy.headers: injected request headers.
- proxy.dispatcher: passed through as non-standard fetch init field
  (useful for Node/undici proxy dispatchers).

Error Model
- Non-2xx responses throw HttpError.
- HttpError fields:
  - status: number
  - statusText: string
  - url: string
  - response: Response
  - body?: unknown (parsed from response when possible)
- statusText fallback:
  - response.statusText
  - or known text from HTTP status reference
  - or "Unknown Status"

HTTP Status Reference Exports
- HTTP_STATUS_TEXTS
- getHttpStatusText(code)
- RETRYABLE_HTTP_STATUS_CODES
- isRetryableHttpStatusCode(code)

Response Parsing
- content-type includes "application/json" => response.json()
- content-type starts with "text/" => response.text()
- empty content-type => response.text() (undefined if empty string)
- otherwise => response.arrayBuffer()
- status 204/205 => undefined

Runtime Requirements
- Global fetch, Headers, AbortController, AbortSignal are required.
- For relative paths outside browser-like runtime, set baseUrl.

Guidance for LLM Code Generation
- Prefer createHttpClient once per API domain.
- Use generics on get/post/request for typed responses.
- Use json option for JSON body instead of manual stringify.
- Catch HttpError for API-level failures.
- Avoid retries for non-idempotent writes unless explicitly requested.
- Keep imports exactly:
  import { createHttpClient, HttpError } from '@rockcoredev/http';
